facts.business: Aaron Industries Limited is a company that maintains inventory of raw materials and finished goods at multiple locations, with closing inventory of Rs. 2442.12 lakhs as at March 31, 2026, constituting approximately 26.78% of total assets.

auditor.name: M/s Dhirren R Dave & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Inventory valuation and physical verification - closing inventory of Rs. 2442.12 lakhs as at March 31, 2026, constituting 26.78% of total assets, with considerable increase at year-end, kept at multiple locations requiring significant judgements and assumptions for physical verification and valuation per Ind AS 2.

key_risks: Inventory valuation and physical verification risk due to large number of items kept at multiple locations with significant judgements and assumptions involved
Considerable increase in inventory at year-end
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not given any loan or provided any guarantee or made any investment under the provision of Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013. Loans given to employees of Rs. 7.57 lakhs outstanding as at March 31, 2026.
